title: Habit Tracker / Streaks App
description: Track your daily habits, maintain streaks, and earn rewards with a fun and motivating interface.
how_to_play:
1. Add the habits you want to track.
2. Mark a habit as completed each day.
3. Claim rewards when all habits are completed.
4. Your streak will increase if you complete all habits consecutively.
5. Reset or edit habits anytime.

Tips:
- Start with small habits to stay consistent.
- Use the streak as motivation to keep going.
- Regularly review and adjust your habits.
